note: Kept per feature as the work goes (Stage 4 builds the PDF and adds the screenshots).

entries.title: One SEO panel on every page type
entries.need: SEO settings were only on some pages, and categories and landing pages had none.
entries.now: Pages, posts, products, categories and landing pages share one panel with all nine SEO controls.
entries.where: Online Store › Pages / Blog posts / Products › a product / Categories / Landing pages › SEO
try: Open a product.
Under Search engine listing press Edit.
Write a description, then open Social share and Structured data.

entries.title: Mark single links nofollow or sponsored
entries.need: Every link counted the same, so paid or customer links could not be marked.
entries.now: Each link in the text can be nofollow, sponsored or user content, and open in a new tab.
entries.where: Any editor › Search engine listing › Links
try: Open a blog post with a link.
In Links press Nofollow and New tab.
Update, then view the post: the link carries them.

entries.title: Bangla titles now make a web address
entries.problem: A Bangla title gave an empty web address.
entries.now: Bangla is written in Latin letters by default, or kept as Bangla if the shop prefers.
try: Add a page titled মোবাইল কভার.
The address becomes /pages/mobail-kabhar.

entries.title: Schedule pages, products and landing pages
entries.need: Only blog posts could go live later; a product's "Go live on a date" had no date.
entries.now: Pick a date and time in Bangladesh time; it goes live by itself then, or cancel it.
try: Open a draft page.
In Schedule pick tomorrow 9:00 AM and save.
The page says when it goes live.

entries.title: Schema made automatically, own schema replaces it
entries.need: Merchants had to write JSON to tell Google about prices, stock and ratings.
entries.now: Products, posts, pages, categories, FAQ and breadcrumbs get schema by themselves; the shop's own JSON-LD replaces the same type.
entries.where: Editor › Search engine listing › Structured data
try: Open a product's Structured data.
Paste an FAQPage schema.
FAQPage is crossed out in Made automatically.

entries.title: Customer pages carry the SEO tags
entries.need: Only store pages had a customer page; none wrote their SEO into the page head.
entries.now: Pages, posts, products, categories and landing pages each have a customer page with one set of SEO tags.
try: Open a product's View on the website.
Inspect the page head: one title, description, canonical and schema.
entries.left: Search engines read the HTML the server sends; here the tags are added after the page loads. The server must write them.

entries.title: Redirects made when an address changes
entries.need: Renaming a product or page broke every old link to it (review ON-F19).
entries.now: A live item's old address redirects to the new one by itself; loops and chains are flagged.
try: Rename a live product and save.
Open SEO › Redirects: old → new is listed.
Open the old address: it lands on the product.

entries.title: SEO health, not found, sitemap and robots.txt
entries.need: There was no way to see SEO problems across the store or control the sitemap.
entries.now: One page scores every live item, lists issues with Fix, logs missing addresses, shows the sitemap and robots.txt.
try: Open Online Store › SEO.
Press Fix on a row with no description.
Write one and save: the issue count drops.
entries.left: The not-found log has demo rows; on the live website it comes from the server's visits.

entries.title: Edit SEO of many items at once
entries.need: Titles and descriptions had to be written one product at a time.
entries.now: A grid edits addresses, titles, descriptions and image alt text for many items, then saves together.
try: Open the bulk editor.
Tick Only missing.
Fill three descriptions and press Save changes.

entries.title: Buy expert help inside GridCommerce
entries.need: Merchants had to find agencies outside for SEO, ads, design or product upload.
entries.now: A Services shop lists ten services with packages, a short brief and payment; monthly ones bill with the subscription.
entries.where: Team & settings › Services › Get expert help (/services)
try: Open Services › Get expert help.
Open SEO and choose Standard.
Answer the brief and pay.
entries.left: Payment is a demo; the gateway is the server's.

entries.title: Follow, approve and rate each service order
entries.need: There was nowhere to talk to an expert or approve their work.
entries.now: Each order shows its steps, messages, files, monthly reports, store-access and extra-work requests, approve or change, and a rating.
try: Open My services.
Open an order and send a message.
Approve a delivery and rate it.

entries.title: Owner approves an expert's store access
entries.need: Experts needed the owner's password or a support PIN to work in a store.
entries.now: The owner approves a limited, timed access in the order; it opens a logged access session for the expert.
entries.where: My services › an order · Super admin › Services › an order
try: In super admin, ask for store access on an order.
In the merchant panel, approve it.
Back in super admin, Start session.

entries.title: Run service orders from super admin
entries.need: GridCommerce had no way to assign, track or check paid service work.
entries.now: An orders board with deadlines that pause while waiting, expert assignment, quality check, extra-work quotes and refunds.
try: Open a New order and assign the suggested expert.
Hand the work in.
Pass the quality check.

entries.title: Catalogue, brief builder and experts
entries.need: Services, prices and the questions asked had no place to be managed.
entries.now: Edit services, packages, add-ons, brief questions, who may buy them, and experts with skills, load and commission.
try: Open Catalogue and a service.
Add a brief question and save.
See it on the merchant's order page.

entries.title: Service money reaches Finance by itself
entries.need: Service sales, partner payouts and refunds were not in the books.
entries.now: Paid charges show in Finance › Income, partner earnings as expenses owed, and sent refunds in Refunds; Reports show the totals.
entries.where: Super admin › Finance › Income / Expenses · Services › Reports
try: Pay for a service in the merchant panel.
Open super admin › Finance › Income.
Find the service charge.

entries.title: Email at the shop's own domain
entries.need: Shops had no way to get name@theirshop.com email from GridCommerce.
entries.now: A setup verifies the domain, shows four DNS records that turn green, then makes mailboxes, aliases, groups and forwarders.
try: Connect a domain in Settings › Domains.
Open Business email, pick a plan and continue.
Check the records, finish, and make a mailbox.
entries.left: Mail itself (servers or a reseller) is the backend's; DNS checks are simulated.

entries.title: Use mail on web and phone
entries.need: There was no way to read the mail or set up a phone.
entries.now: Webmail opens from Apps; a QR code and the IMAP / SMTP settings set up phones; old mail can be imported.
try: Open Business email › Apps.
Scan the QR code, or open webmail.
Start an import from an old host.
entries.left: Webmail is a stand-in for the provider's.

entries.title: Mailboxes follow staff joining and leaving
entries.need: Mailboxes had to be made and closed by hand when staff changed.
entries.now: Inviting a user can make their mailbox; marking someone as left suspends it and forwards their mail.
entries.where: Settings › Users & roles · Staff & HR › a person › Leaving
try: Invite a user with the mailbox box ticked.
Mark a staff member as left.
See their mailbox suspended and forwarded.

entries.title: Buy mailboxes and storage
entries.need: Mail could not be sized or billed.
entries.now: Plan & usage shows seats, storage and the monthly cost, and buys more mailboxes or storage; a plan includes some free.
try: Open Plan & usage.
Buy 10 GB more.
See the new monthly cost.

entries.title: Order emails from the shop's domain
entries.need: Order emails always came from a GridCommerce address.
entries.now: Once SPF and DKIM are green, order and notification emails go out from orders@ the shop's domain.
entries.where: Business email › Domain & DNS · Order notifications
try: Open Domain & DNS.
See the sending address.
Open Order notifications: it shows there too.
entries.left: The send layer must use this address on the server.

entries.title: Mail directory, prices and abuse in super admin
entries.need: GridCommerce could not see stores' mail, price it or stop abuse.
entries.now: A directory with DNS health, usage, revenue against provider cost and alerts; plans and provider; sending limits and suspension.
try: Open Business email › Directory.
Open a domain with an alert.
Suspend a mailbox with a reason.

entries.title: Today's sales compared fairly with yesterday
entries.problem: Home compared today so far with the whole of yesterday, so mornings always looked like a big drop.
entries.now: Today is compared with yesterday up to the same time of day.
try: Open Home in the morning.
The Sales change compares with yesterday by this time.

entries.title: A product keeps its own VAT rate
entries.problem: The VAT / tax box on Add product was not saved; every product used its category's rate.
entries.now: The product's VAT is saved; the register, Create order and order links use it before the category's.
try: Set a product to 5% VAT and save.
Ring it up at the register: VAT is 5%.

entries.title: Order links no longer add VAT on top
entries.problem: The order-link page added 5% VAT on top of prices that already include VAT.
entries.now: It follows the VAT setup: with prices that include VAT, it shows the VAT inside the total.
try: Open an order link with VAT on.
The total equals the items plus delivery; VAT shows as included.

entries.title: Customer badge shows the real loyalty tier
entries.problem: The demo customer always showed a Gold badge, whatever they spent.
entries.now: The badge is the loyalty tier from what the customer bought.
try: Open the demo customer.
The badge matches their spend (Member, Silver, Gold or Platinum).

entries.title: IMEI asked when packing a courier order
entries.problem: Phones going by courier (also from quotes) left without their IMEI numbers recorded.
entries.now: Packing asks each piece's IMEI or serial; the parcel can't be ready or sent without them.
entries.where: Orders › an approved order › Prepare parcel (web and phone)
try: Approve an order with a phone.
Prepare parcel asks for the IMEI.
Type it; the order becomes ready.

entries.title: Wholesale switch read at the right time
entries.problem: Three lists read the wholesale switch when the app loaded, before the edition preview was known.
entries.now: Return channels, import columns and quotes read it when the page shows them.
try: Preview an edition with ?edition=.
Open Returns history: its tabs follow it.

entries.title: GridAI button no longer covers Save
entries.problem: On computers the floating GridAI button sat on top of the Save button of save bars.
entries.now: When a page has a save bar, the GridAI button sits above it.
entries.where: Add product, Settings pages, bulk editors
try: Change a product so the save bar shows.
The GridAI button sits above Save.

skipped.what: Keyword-rank tracking, backlink tools, AI meta for every product by default
